rules.power_valid: Finite nonnegative power, valid native-grid timestamp, no duplicate key; zero power counted separately.
rules.duplicate_policy: All repeated node/timestamp keys excluded from strict continuity, including identical repeats.
rules.duration: N consecutive samples * native interval; last timestamp is inclusive. A day is 24 hours.
rules.complete_calendar_day: 96 valid unique points (M100) or 144 (UCC) in a date; UTC for M100, unresolved local clock for UCC.
rules.joint_valid: Power-valid plus finite declared core auxiliary fields; no imputation or extra physical filters.
rules.high_power_flag: Above per-node Q3 + 3*IQR; descriptive diagnostic only, never auto-deleted.
rules.time_semantics: M100 timestamps UTC; aggregation boundary/sample counts not established by this audit. UCC CSV timestamps are timezone-naive.
rules.scope: Both local M100 tarballs only, not all racks; both full UCC CSVs; distinct datasets/hosts are never summed as facility power.
